name: Windspire
descriptionSeed: An elven sky city anchored to the eastern peaks by chains a mile long. Its people come down to trade and to fight at the Crossing, and climb back up as though the ground were slightly embarrassing.
encounterFlavor: elven glider-riders, anchor-wardens, and Somatic climbers who have come to try the chains
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: placed on the world's own mountain (Erik 2026-10-04: "they live in pockets across the world, in the typical places of their kind").
appearance: Spires on a floating crag, chains as thick as a man running down to anchor-forts on the peaks, and gliders circling the anchor-lines.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
